environment.isolation: Existing generic WSL sklearn/RDKit runtime, task-owned source/data; no shared environment changes

numerical_policy.notes: Actual sklearn/RDKit/NumPy/SciPy versions, complete effective RF get_params and numeric feature dtype receipt required before any real issuance; no Torch/GPU path used by RF.

resources.start_gate: Pending actual live CPU/memory capacity. At most4 CPU-only workers with1thread and2GiB RSS each; coexistence must not preempt original NN jobs; lower concurrency if live reservation unavailable
resources.budget_basis: Root preregistered extra classical comparison before any holdout predictions; bounded optional auxiliary stage must not block five core methods

execution.seed_policy: Exactly0–9; same fixed NN cohort-wide partitions; one RF seed per unit and two fixed leaf candidates; validation only

process_control.mechanism: Pending actual CPU private-PGID supervisor; four workers max, whole-tree RSS and original deadline guard

stop_conditions: 出现平台拒绝或缺少适用授权

features.peptide: Morgan radius2/2048bits/useChirality=true on full ligand graph
features.target: first1000 amino acids; AAC20 +dipeptide400 +length; exact numeric definitions/dtypes frozen by actual code before fitting

baseline_metadata.all_other_effective_parameters: Must be explicitly captured from the actual installed sklearn regressor; defaults are not guessed here
baseline_metadata.selection: minimum validation MAE; fixed candidate order leaf2 then5 breaks exact ties; no test-based decision
baseline_metadata.joint_holdout_policy: Root high-level scoring authorization additionally requires RF40 frozen or a preregistered resource/asset failure terminal decision; original NN200 scorer gate remains unchanged
baseline_metadata.optional_failure_policy: Record bounded preparation/fit failures and actual resource/asset reason; do not hold five core methods hostage or choose RF inclusion using holdout scores
